title: Total DNA Extraction from Plant Samples
author: Vahid Jalali Javaran

steps.title: Prepare Reagents
steps.instruction: Prepare the CTAB buffer and ethanol solution.

substeps.instruction: Autoclave CTAB buffer for 20 minutes.
Add 1% β-mercaptoethanol to the CTAB buffer just before use.
Incubate the CTAB buffer at 65°C for at least 15 minutes before use.
Pre-chill 75% ethanol at -20°C.
Ensure sodium acetate (NaAc) solution is ready.

steps.title: Weigh Plant Material
steps.instruction: Measure 100-150 mg of plant sample and transfer it to a 2 mL microcentrifuge tube.

steps.title: Homogenize the Sample
steps.instruction: Grind the plant material using bead beating.

substeps.instruction: Add 4 beads to the tube.
Perform bead beating for 15 seconds at 3000 rpm in the presence of liquid nitrogen.
Check for uniform grinding; repeat if necessary.

steps.title: Extract DNA with CTAB Buffer
steps.instruction: Lysis of the sample using preheated CTAB buffer.

substeps.instruction: Add 750 μL of preheated CTAB buffer to the sample.
Vortex vigorously for 1 minute.
Incubate at 65°C for 30-60 minutes (longer for woody plants).

steps.title: Centrifuge and Collect Supernatant
steps.instruction: Separate the lysate from the debris.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at 15,700 g for 5 minutes.
Transfer approximately 700 μL of supernatant to a new tube.

steps.title: Perform Chloroform:Isoamyl Alcohol Extraction
steps.instruction: Purify the extract using chloroform:isoamyl alcohol (24:1).

substeps.instruction: Add 1 volume (700 μL) of chloroform:isoamyl alcohol (24:1).
Vortex for 1 minute.
Centrifuge at 15,700 g for 10 minutes.
Repeat the washing step if necessary, especially for samples with high amounts of polysaccharides and polyphenols.
Transfer 600 μL of the supernatant to a new tube.
Add 6 μL RNase A (20 mg/mL).
Incubate at 37°C for 30 minutes.
Add 1 volume of chloroform:isoamyl alcohol (24:1) to the sample.
Vortex for 1 minute.
Centrifuge at 15,700 g for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Precipitate DNA
steps.instruction: Precipitate the DNA using sodium acetate and ethanol.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 500 μL of the supernatant to a clean tube.
Add 0.1 volume of 3 M sodium acetate (NaAc) and 2.5-3 volumes of 100% ethanol.
Invert the tube gently to mix.
Incubate at -20°C for 20 minutes (longer incubation may precipitate smaller fragments but increases risk of contaminants or degradation).
Centrifuge at 15,700 g for 15 minutes at 4°C.

steps.title: Wash the DNA Pellet
steps.instruction: Choose one of two options to rinse the pellet.

substeps.instruction: Option 1 (Rinsing): Add 1 mL of cold 75% ethanol to the side of the tube, gently swirl to rinse without dissolving, and discard ethanol (repeat once). Recommended for shorter incubation times.

Option 2 (Dissolving): Completely dissolve the pellet in 1 mL of cold 75% ethanol by gently mixing, then centrifuge at 15,700 g for 10 minutes at 4°C to re-precipitate (repeat once). Recommended for longer/overnight incubation.
Carefully discard the supernatant and air-dry the tubes for 10-15 minutes (do not over-dry).
Add 51 µL of DNase-free water to the tube.
Optional: Incubate at 50°C for 5 minutes on a preheated heating block or water bath to facilitate dissolution.
Use 1 µL of the solution with a Nanodrop or equivalent spectrophotometer to measure DNA concentration and quality.
